Here’s an improved prompt with clearer structure, specificity, and actionable goals — written in a way a prompt engineer would craft it to ensure high-quality, focused output:

---

**Prompt (Optimized):**

> I want to master **Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) in C++**, starting from **1st July**, over the course of **1 month**.  
> 
> **Background**:
> - I have already covered most of the **C++ basics**.
> - I’m currently following Apna College’s Complete DSA C++ Playlist:  
>   https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLfqMhTWNBTe137I_EPQd34TsgV6IO55pt  
> 
> **Goal**:
> - To **deeply understand both DSA theory and implementation** in C++.
> - To build a strong problem-solving habit (1 question a day minimum).
> 
> **Time Commitment**:
> - **30–45 minutes daily for theory/video**.
> - **Enough time to solve at least 1 quality DSA question daily**.
> 
> **Instructions**:
> 1. Create a **day-by-day study plan** (from July 1 to July 31).
> 2. Specify **which topic/concept/video** to cover each day.
> 3. Recommend **one or more coding questions** per day from platforms like LeetCode, CodeStudio, or GFG (links preferred).
> 4. Include **milestones or checkpoints** every week to track progress.
> 5. Mention any **high-quality free/paid resources** (under ₹1000 if possible) that can supplement Apna College’s course.

Please structure the output as a **daily schedule** with clarity. I want to stay focused and build a DSA routine that sharpens my logic, builds my concepts, and prepares me for future interviews.

---

Let me know if you want this prompt to be targeted toward a particular level (e.g., beginner to intermediate, or intermediate to advanced), or if you want me to generate the actual 1-month DSA plan now.

Here’s the **improved and polished prompt**, structured professionally like a prompt engineer would write it, with clarity, precision, and impact:

---

### 🔧 Optimized Prompt:  
> I want to **master Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) in C++** starting from **1st July**, with a focused **1-month plan** tailored for **beginner to intermediate level**.
>  
> #### 🧠 My Background:
> - I’ve already completed **most of the C++ basics** (syntax, OOP, STL).
> - I’m currently following Apna College’s [DSA in C++ YouTube Playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLfqMhTWNBTe137I_EPQd34TsgV6IO55pt).
> - I’m **open to other high-quality playlists or resources** (YouTube, free/paid under ₹1000) that are **well-regarded by top candidates** who’ve cracked DSA rounds at top tech companies.
>
> #### 🎯 My Goals:
> - Gain **strong conceptual understanding** of core DSA topics.
> - Build a **daily problem-solving habit** (minimum 1 good-quality question/day).
> - Prepare effectively for **coding rounds of product-based companies** (Amazon, Google, Flipkart, etc.).
>
> #### ⏱ Time Commitment:
> - **30–45 minutes/day** for theory (video or reading).
> - **Time to solve at least one well-selected coding question daily**.
>
> #### 📝 What I Need From You:
> 1. A **daily study plan (1st July – 31st July)** organized by topic.
> 2. For each day:
>    - Specify **topic/concept to study**.
>    - Recommend **specific video/resource** (with links).
>    - Suggest **1–2 handpicked problems** (with platform links like LeetCode, GFG, CodeStudio).
> 3. Provide **weekly checkpoints or review days** to revise, reinforce, or attempt mock questions.
> 4. Suggest **supplemental resources** (e.g., practice sheets, PDFs, mock tests, short courses under ₹1000) if any.
> 5. Ensure the plan is **balanced but intensive enough** to make visible progress in a month.
>
> 🔍 Please research thoroughly — use well-validated sources, YouTube educators, GitHub roadmaps, interview experiences, and anything shared by people who’ve **cracked DSA rounds at top companies**.  

Structure the response as a **clear, day-wise schedule**, with emphasis on real-world relevance, practical learning, and consistency.

---

Let me know if you want me to **run this prompt now** and generate the 31-day plan for you.
